references.text: The fear of the Lord is pure; it endures forever. The judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
When they say to you, 'Consult the ghosts and the mediums who whisper and mutter!' – should not a people consult their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
And the report about this went out through all that land.

Then fear came upon them all, and they glorified God, saying, 'A great prophet has arisen among us,' and, 'God has visited his people.' And this word about him spread throughout Judea and all the surrounding country.
